title: India-Nigeria Packaging Skills Development Program
summary: A joint Rotary vocational skills project between the Rotary Club of Mumbai Coastline, India and the Rotary Club of Apakun Ajao Estate, Nigeria.
description: A joint Rotary vocational skills project between the Rotary Club of Mumbai Coastline, India and the Rotary Club of Apakun Ajao Estate, Nigeria. The program will introduce 20-25 students to packaging machinery, factory operations and industrial practices through classroom learning, supervised practical exposure, factory visits and interaction with industry professionals. The objective is to improve practical skills, employability and create opportunities for internships and jobs. Selected IPMMI online PackTalk sessions may also be included, subject to approval. The project was formally initiated in Lagos on 10 September 2026. The project contribution was handed over and Rotary flags were exchanged, marking the beginning of this joint India-Nigeria initiative.
